context: Tests whether the agent writes a service object spec following the write-tests skill conventions: correct spec type selection, proper structure, TDD proof with realistic output labels, and convention adherence.

checklist.name: Frozen string literal
checklist.description: The spec file starts with `# frozen_string_literal: true` as the very first line

checklist.name: Mirrored file path
checklist.description: The spec file path mirrors the source: `app/services/payments/charge_card.rb` → `spec/services/payments/charge_card_spec.rb`

checklist.name: subject(:result) defined
checklist.description: Uses `subject(:result)` to invoke `.call` on the described class

checklist.name: describe '.call' structure
checklist.description: Uses `describe '.call' do` as the outer describe block for the class method

checklist.name: No 'and' in descriptions
checklist.description: No `it` or `specify` description contains the word 'and' — each example tests a single behavior

checklist.name: Stripe mocked at class level
checklist.description: Stubs `StripeClient` (or equivalent external dependency) using `allow(StripeClient).to receive(...)` — not an instance double

checklist.name: No ActiveRecord mocking
checklist.description: Does NOT mock or stub any ActiveRecord finder methods (e.g., `User.find`, `where`, etc.)

checklist.name: Observed RED label used
checklist.description: TDD proof uses the literal label `Observed RED output` (not 'Expected output', 'Planned output', or similar)

checklist.name: Observed GREEN label used
checklist.description: TDD proof uses the literal label `Observed GREEN output` (not 'Expected output' or similar) for the passing run

checklist.name: Multiple GREEN verification levels
checklist.description: Presents at least two separate Observed GREEN output blocks: one for the focused spec and one for the broader suite or full file

checklist.name: aggregate_failures used
checklist.description: Uses `aggregate_failures` block in at least one example that checks multiple related properties

checklist.name: context 'when' naming
checklist.description: All context blocks use `context 'when ...'` or `context 'with ...'` phrasing — not used to group methods

checklist.name: Resource loading documented
checklist.description: answer.md includes a section documenting which assets (e.g., tdd_proof_checklist.md, output_checklist.md) were consulted and why

checklist.name: Self-audit included
checklist.description: answer.md includes a self-audit checklist confirming no 'and' in descriptions, let! justifications, and factory persistence choices
